answer: Reaching eligibility takes 27 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The dawn register is checked at draw time, island lists the eligible set, and ridge seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 27 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 334 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
